verdict.rationale: Greptile's review automation can be defined as config-as-code in a repository-root greptile.json. Settings are read from the PR's source branch and override the dashboard, so config changes travel with branches and PRs and can be reviewed and reverted alongside code. Versioning, review and rollback come from the user's git workflow rather than a Greptile-native mechanism, and dashboard-level settings have no documented history. Missing for 10: native version history of automation/review settings, built-in diff/review of config changes, one-click rollback, audit trail for dashboard settings, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Place `greptile.json` in your repository root. Settings are read from the source branch of the PR and override dashboard settings.
Control review behavior, PR filters, file patterns, custom context, and output formatting.
Create custom rules, upload style guides, and configure repository-specific standards via greptile.json.
